item.title: Tombstone Said To Be An Important Character In New SPIDER-MAN Trilogy - & Could Lay The Groundwork For Kingpin
item.description: According to a new rumor, Tombstone (Marvin Jones III) will have a small role in Spider-Man: Brand New Day, but play an important part across the next Spidey trilogy...

item.title: F1 Driver Esteban Ocon Reveals Marvel-Inspired Helmet For Las Vegas Grand Prix Featuring SPIDER-MAN And VENOM
item.description: Formula 1 driver Esteban Ocon has unveiled yet another Marvel-inspired helmet ahead of this weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix, and it finally brings Spider-Man and Venom together. You can check it out here...

item.title: All Signs Point To Massive DRAGON BALL SUPER News Dropping In January
item.description: Fans have spent years hoping for new chapters of the Dragon Ball Super anime or manga, and it finally seems like their patience may be on the verge of paying off!

item.title: Purported THE AMAZING SPIDER-MAN 2 Prop Pictures Give Close Look At Norman Osborn’s Gruesome Detached Head
item.description: The Amazing Spider-Man 2 was supposed to feature Norman Osborn’s detached head in a post-credits scene. Now, supposed pictures for the prop have surfaced… and it feels too gruesome for a superhero film.

item.title: GOOD FORTUNE Star/Director Aziz Ansari On Working With Keanu Reeves, His Comedy Evolution & More! (Exclusive)
item.description: With his latest film Good Fortune now available on Digital HD, we were granted an exclusive opportunity to sit down with the one and only Aziz Ansari to talk about his feature film directorial debut!

item.title: Is WICKED 3 Happening? WICKED: FOR GOOD Writer Talks Possible Threequel Following Huge Preview Box Office Haul
item.description: As Wicked: For Good racks up the year's biggest preview screening haul at the North American box office, screenwriter Dana Fox weighs in on the possibility of Wicked 3 becoming a reality. Check it out!

item.title: STAR WARS: THE LAST JEDI Director Rian Johnson's Long-Delayed Trilogy Is, Somewhat Unsurprisingly, "Dead"
item.description: Lucasfilm announced plans for Star Wars: The Last Jedi writer and director Rian Johnson to helm a new trilogy in 2017. It still hasn't materialised, and according to a new report, likely never will...

item.title: Brendan Fraser Talks Almost Starring In SUPERMAN: FLYBY; Reveals X-MEN 3 Director Helmed His Screen Test
item.description: Brendan Fraser has opened up about nearly being cast as Clark Kent in Superman: Flyby, detailing his audition process and revealing an interesting detail about his screen test.

item.title: BLACK ADAM Star Noah Centineo In Talks For Live-Action GUNDAM; Plot Details Point To One Year War Setting
item.description: After missing out on playing He-Man in Masters of the Universe, Street Fighter star Noah Centineo is being eyed for another major franchise as the actor is in talks to lead Gundam with Sydney Sweeney.

item.title: WONDER WOMAN Star Gal Gadot Says She’d Love To Play SNOW WHITE’s Evil Queen Again In Potential Spinoff
item.description: It doesn’t look like Snow White will get a continuation anytime soon, but Wonder Woman star Gal Gadot—who portrayed the Evil Queen in the film—says she’d love to reprise the role given the opportunity.
